IWPB Chief Operating Office (IWPB COO)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking, we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers look after their day-to-day finances and manage, protect and grow their wealth. The International Wealth and Premier Banking Chief Operating Office supports the business to deliver exceptional customer journeys and increase efficiency across our global network. We support the business through effective governance, financial and risk management, transformation, and operational management, ensuring that all International Wealth and Premier Banking business units and markets have the right capabilities and procedures to compete effectively and grow safely. We work in an agile manner and at pace, partnering with teams in Technology and Digital Business Services to bring innovative, digital-first solutions to our customers.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • 运用已有知识和既定流程与指引，处理来自内部和/或外部客户的要求
  • 负责日常任务执行，并可指导其他团队成员
  • 该岗位要求具备通过实际工作经验、培训或教育背景所获得的专业领域知识
  • 确保监管报表报送的及时性、准确性、完整性、合规性
  • 统计资料归档
  • 遵守各监管机构发布的相关统计及会计政策和条例

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

所需知识：

  • 丰富的银行运营知识
  • 相关的理财产品知识
  • 了解合规与监管要求

所需技能：

  • 问题解决能力
  • 积极工作态度，以应对在时间压力下高业务量的工作
  • 良好的英语听说读写能力
  • 优秀的沟通能力

主要挑战：

  • 在有限时间内处理多个复杂客户指令；
  • 配合团队成员，以达到高标准的服务质量和工作效率；
  • 在资源有限的情况下，承受工作压力并保持高效运作。

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4459166832.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Business Analyst.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end BA delivery across Data Control initiatives: DMOV, DSTO, DQ, and retention/lifecycle controls.
  • Elicit, analyse, and document requirements; translate into epics/features/user stories with clear acceptance criteria and traceability.
  • Define requirements for ingestion, storage patterns/tiering, and distribution, including interfaces, mappings, dependencies, and NFRs.
  • Drive data retention and disposal requirements (retention schedules, legal holds, exceptions), ensuring solutions are implementable and auditable.
  • Embed governance, risk, and control requirements (classification, access, auditability, metadata/lineage) into delivery outcomes.
  • Support SIT/UAT, defect triage, release readiness, and BAU handover.
  • Manage senior stakeholders, facilitate workshops, and coach junior BAs to raise analysis quality and consistency.

Requirements

  • Strong BA experience delivering complex technology change (Agile and/or hybrid).
  • Solid knowledge of data movement and storage concepts (batch/streaming, landing/curation layers, tiering).
  • Demonstrable experience defining data retention/lifecycle requirements and translating them into delivery-ready stories and controls.
  • Strong stakeholder management across Technology, Data Governance, and control/risk teams.
  • Excellent facilitation and documentation skills; able to turn ambiguity into structured, testable requirements.
  • Experience with cloud/hybrid data platforms, data catalogue, and lineage tooling.
  • Working knowledge of privacy/security controls (masking, tokenisation, encryption, audit logging).
  • Experience operating within a financial services control environment.
  • SQL and/or data profiling experience to validate requirements and DQ rules.
  • PMP / PRINCE2 (or equivalent) certification.
  • BCBS 239 practical experience in a bank (e.g., lineage, DQ controls, ownership/stewardship, governance/audit evidence).
  • Able to work with limited documentation; proactive, self-sufficient, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong English communication and collaboration skills across global teams/time zones.
  • Continuous improvement mindset and curiosity to understand how platforms/systems work end-to-end.

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Prior experience working with Architecture Engineering / Solution Architecture teams.
  • 6+ years in data-focused delivery/analysis.
  • 3+ years working in Agile/DevOps environments.
  • Typical tools：Jira/Confluence, Visio/Lucidchart/Miro, SQL/query & profiling tools, catalogue/metadata tools.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID:51066

Principal Responsibilities

  • Serve as the key technical enabler for the China-based team, owning architecture and engineering direction for CDMS services.
  • Lead solution design and technical decision-making across Java/Spring Boot/Spring Cloud microservices landscapes.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs, implementation plans, and engineering deliverables.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, resilient applications and APIs for customer journey initiatives.
  • Establish and enforce engineering standards through code reviews, secure coding practices, and quality gates.
  • Drive adoption of design patterns and clean architecture principles to improve maintainability, reusability, and extensibility.
  • Lead and mentor developers, especially junior/new team members, to improve capability, delivery quality, and team velocity.
  • Own production support and service management, including collaboration with internal teams and third-party vendors.
  • Manage incidents/problems within SLA targets; lead root-cause analysis and preventive improvement actions.
  • Partner with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines, release reliability, observability, and operational readiness.
  • Continuously benchmark and optimize system performance across application, database, and integration layers.
  • Contribute to strategic technology initiatives and department-level engineering improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption in engineering and business scenarios, including intelligent automation, assistant/recommendation capabilities, and AI service integration.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or related disciplines.
  • 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven track record as a Senior Java Engineer / Tech Lead.
  • Strong expertise in Java, Spring ecosystem, J2EE, and SQL, with solid object-oriented design and coding fundamentals.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Spring Boot; good practical knowledge of Spring Cloud and microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience in RESTful API design/development; practical knowledge of API protocols/technologies (e.g., REST, WebSocket).
  • Good hands-on knowledge of relational databases and NoSQL technologies (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
  • Practical understanding of event-driven architecture and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong grasp of software design patterns, clean architecture, and engineering best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
  • Strong DevOps knowledge, including CI/CD, automated testing, code quality/security scanning, release governance, and observability.
  • Practical experience with engineering toolchain such as Git, Jenkins, SonarQube (or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated AI capability, including exposure to or hands-on delivery in LLM/API integration, intelligent workflow automation, or AI-assisted product features.
  • Strong ability to interpret business requirements in English and convert them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Solid skills in profiling, benchmarking, and performance optimization.
  • Excellent communication, cross-team collaboration, ownership mindset, and leadership under delivery pressure.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist (GenAI Agent Platforms).

Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an / Shenzhen

Job ID: 45919

Principal Responsibilities

  • GenAI Agent platform engineering: design and develop the agent runtime, orchestration, tool/function calling, prompt and workflow management, memory/state handling, and integration patterns—leveraging frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph (where appropriate) while avoiding unnecessary vendor/framework lock-in.
  • Continuously monitor and optimise platform performance in production, including model selection, prompt/agent tuning, retrieval quality, caching, throughput, and resilience; drive root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.
  • Embed security, privacy and compliance by design & development: ensure controls for data handling, access management, encryption, auditability, model risk considerations, and safe tool use; align to internal governance and relevant regulatory expectations.
  • Maintain platform documentation and enablement: publish reference design, APIs/SDKs, templates, testing, and developer guidance to accelerate adoption and consistent delivery across teams.
  • Track and evaluate emerging GenAI/agent capabilities (e.g., new orchestration patterns, evaluation methods, safety techniques, model/tooling advances) and translate them into pragmatic platform enhancements with clear value, risk and cost trade-offs.

Requirements

  • Education & English: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science/Engineering (or related);
  • Software Engineering: 2+ years’ handon coding practice, strong Python or Java or Golang, with usage of at least one major cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP); ability to deploy and operate services in production (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
  • Demonstrates an AI-native mindset by applying AI-driven approaches, including coding assistants, to improve productivity, quality, and engineering best practices
  • GenAI / LLM Delivery: knowledge with any one in GenAI, LLMs, MCP, RAG agentic workflows, tool/function calling will be a plus

ln:4455283238.descriptionHtml:
Coverage Banking Internship Programme 2027

Join our Coverage Banking team and gain first-hand experience supporting some of the world’s leading corporates, financial institutions, investors and public sector clients. As part of the client-facing arm of Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB), you’ll work alongside experienced bankers to help deliver integrated banking solutions, build client relationships and support strategic growth opportunities across markets.

With our unique international footprint, you’ll gain exposure to cross-border business, global clients and real-world banking challenges. You’ll work across teams, products and geographies while developing the commercial, analytical and relationship-building skills that underpin a successful career in banking.

Join us if you’re curious about how businesses grow, how financial markets operate and how trusted client relationships are built.

About the Internship Programme – how you’ll learn and grow 

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over 10 weeks, you’ll work on real business challenges, build future-ready skills, and gain insight into how we support clients, facilitate trade and finance growth across our markets. Working alongside colleagues across our global network, you’ll develop the skills, confidence and connections to accelerate your career. For many interns, this is the first step towards a graduate role with us.

The Programme Will Support Your Development Through

  • A 10-week summer internship 
  • A structured induction and orientation 
  • Exposure to our products, clients and international network
  • Real projects and meaningful responsibilities from day one
  • Technical, professional and behavioural skills development
  • Support from managers, mentors and buddies
  • Opportunities to learn from senior leaders and industry experts
  • Community and volunteering initiatives.

Where you could work

You will be placed into one of the following Coverage Banking teams, working alongside experienced bankers to support client relationships, business development activities and transaction execution across our global franchise.

  • Corporate Coverage: Support relationship teams managing multinational corporations, large local corporates and mid-market clients. You’ll gain exposure to financing solutions, transaction banking, capital markets activities and strategic client engagement while learning how long-term client relationships are developed and managed.
  • Financial Institutions Coverage: Work with teams covering banks, insurance companies, asset managers, sovereign entities and other financial institutions. You’ll gain insight into how financial institutions access financing, manage risk and utilise the Bank’s global capabilities to support their businesses.
  • Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Gain exposure to landmark transactions including acquisitions, divestments, mergers and strategic partnerships. You’ll support research, analysis and deal execution activities while learning how clients navigate transformational business decisions.

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We’re Looking For People Who Can

  • Take ownership and show initiative.
  • Think critically and solve problems using logic and sound judgement.
  • Learn quickly, stay curious and seek opportunities to grow.
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Adapt and perform in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, industries and global markets.
  • Communicate confidently and work effectively across different cultures and backgrounds.

Eligibility   

To be eligible for this internship, you should be a penultimate year student, able to intern in June 2027, and start full time in July 2028. You should have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.   

You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.

Key Dates

  • Assessment Centres: October 2026 onwards
  • Start Date: June 2027

About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) 

We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it’s needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

- Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Gain exposure to landmark transactions including acquisitions, divestments, mergers and strategic partnerships. You’ll support research, analysis and deal execution activities while learning how clients navigate transformational business decisions.
Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career
We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.
We’re Looking For People Who Can
- Take ownership and show initiative.
- Think critically and solve problems using logic and sound judgement.
- Learn quickly, stay curious and seek opportunities to grow.
- Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others.
- Adapt and perform in a fast-paced environment.
- Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, industries and global markets.
- Communicate confidently and work effectively across different cultures and backgrounds.
Eligibility
To be eligible for this internship, you should be a penultimate year student, able to intern in June 2027, and start full time in July 2028. You should have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.

- Assessment Centres: October 2026 onwards
- Start Date: June 2027

We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

The Securities & Derivatives Intmd Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for processing orders and transactions originating from trading desks and branch offices in coordination with the Operations - Transaction Services team. The overall objective of this role is to facilitate the clearance, settlement and investigation of client securities and derivatives transactions.

Responsibilities

  • Process securities transactions, provide analytic input for traders and aid in review of derivative products
  • Utilize data analysis tools and methodologies, in conjunction with professional judgement to make process improvement recommendations
  • Resolve settlement related issues and escalate as needed; recommend solutions to resolve complex issues
  • Participate in the implementation of assigned projects, including new products, services and upgrades to platforms
  • Identify policy gaps and formulate new policies to enhance the streamlining of trade flow processes
  • Monitor and provide solutions to errors to minimize risk to the bank
  • Provide informal guidance, and/or on the job training to new team members
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of relevant experience
  • Demonstrated comprehension of Treasury products, accounting and regulatory policies
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills


Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree/University degree or equivalent experience in Business, Accounting, or Finance


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

Our Business

The Head of Trade in China is responsible for driving the growth agenda of trade in China at Bank of America. This includes the development and execution of the Trade Strategy in China from an end-to-end product management and product sales perspective in collaboration with Treasury Sales, Corporate Bank and the rest of the franchise. The Head of Trade will be leading a team of product and program management team as well as coordinate the specialized product sales team in China to deliver these results.

China is an important growth market for Global Payment Solutions GPS) at Bank of America and Trade and Supply Chain Finance is a critical component of GPS. Trade and Supply Chain Finance serve our financial institutions and corporate clients through a wide range of trade finance products ranging from traditional trade documentary trade to supply chain solutions and short-term export credit agency backed financing.

Responsibilities:

  • Development and execution of the China Trade Strategy in alignment with the Global and Regional Trade Strategies to achieve the Trade growth plans for China
  • Responsibility of the Trade Revenue plan, Trade Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet in China to ensure that the trade business meets all its required revenue and return targets. This also includes supporting regular revenue, balance sheet, and asset projections across Trade products in China.
  • Drive the Trade Specialized Product Sales (SPS) agenda in China overseeing the trade sales activity, pipeline development and execution in the market.
  • Partnering closely with Treasury Sales Officers, Corporate Bankers and regional SPS to identify priority clients and opportunities, manage client planning, originate new business and accelerate deal progression from origination through execution and revenue realization
  • Promote solutions-led approach to Trade Sales connecting traditional trade capabilities with broader working capital, payments, liquidity and foreign exchange considerations where relevant to deliver more holistic client solutions
  • End-to-end product development ensuring that all new product build and enhancements have a viable business case, built in the framework of our risk discipline and tracked for commercialization in collaboration with all business partners
  • Partner with Operations, Technology and other risk partners to maintain the on-going end-to-end product delivery model of existing products with discipline to ensure such products are continuously delivered with improved client experience and ease of doing business
  • Keep abreast of regulatory developments and changes in the China operating environment, assessing implications and opportunities for clients and the Trade business and communicating these to country and regional stakeholders. Work with risk partners on the implementation of required changes arising from such regulatory developments
  • Represent GPS Trade in relevant in-country governance forums, including business controls and risk management committees, and ensure appropriate oversight of matters affecting the Trade business
  • Coordinate Trade related regulatory and internal audit, compliance testing activity, working with relevant control and functional partners to ensure issues are addressed appropriately
  • Represent the bank as a Trade thought leader in external forums, industry discussions and client events, bringing perspectives on working capital, supply chains, trade flows and evolving market developments
  • Maintain competitive benchmarking of our trade products with our key competitors in order to identify product gaps, enhancements and plan to market
  • Act as the conduit between China and the regional and global Trade organization, sharing market opportunities and client insights, leveraging expertise across markets and supporting consistent regional and global sales execution on multinational opportunities.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership skills with over 10-15 years relevant trade finance experience in China who will be able to independently grow the trade business agenda.
  • Critical and strategic mindset required to develop a Trade China Strategy and Business Plan
  • Extensive sales and client management knowledge with clients operating in China and strong sales pipeline management discipline
  • Strong understanding of the whole spectrum of Trade Finance products across the working capital cycle and how to leverage such products to provide holistic solutions across cash and liquidity management, risk mitigation and FX.
  • Extensive analytical and financial acumen with experience in forecasting, balance sheet management, and performance reporting.
  • Knowledge of regulatory governance, risk management, and control frameworks affecting Trade products with experience in handling regulatory inspections and examinations and regulatory reporting
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across Product, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Sales, and Technology teams locally, regionally and globally.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Fluent written and spoken English and Chinese.
